notes.title: New MMR System and more...
notes.content:
New MMR System
Based on the feedback received and how demotivating it was to play against opponents from other leagues due to the difference in MMR gained or lost, we have changed the system of increment and decrement as follows:

Winning Match -
+20 MMR points for defeating an opponent in your same league
+15 MMR points for defeating someone from a lower league
+25 MMR points for defeating an opponent in a higher league

Losing Match -
-10 MMR points for losing against someone in your same league
-15 MMR points for losing against a rival from a lower league
-5 MMR points for losing against an opponent from a higher league

Disconnections
We made improvements to prevent some disconnections that could occur, and there is no penalty for MMR loss when the disconnection is involuntary.

Bug Fixes
We also made corrections and minor improvements.

How to give feedback
You are more than welcome to communicate with us through the channel of your preference. You can write to us in the discussion area on Steam or send us an email at support@batovi.com. Or even better! You can join the conversation with our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/dJAenYrz9G

notes.title: Achievements and more!
notes.content:
Achievements
In response to user requests, we've programmed a series of achievements designed to reward players who have gotten "almost everything" the game has to offer! :)

Improved Matchmaking
We've improved the matchmaking system, fixing an issue that could occur in some cases where, after finding an opponent, the system would freeze.

Experience Points
We've made an adjustment that no longer allows players to earn experience points if they leave the match without playing.

Remote Match Information
We've added information about the additional minutes being played in a remote match when we're waiting for the end of the first or second half, letting us know that the other game is still running.

Post-Match Screen
We've added information to the post-match screen, making it clearer to see the results of XP, MMR, and leaderboard position, depending on whether you've won, drawn, or lost.

How to give feedback
You are more than welcome to communicate with us through the channel of your preference. You can write to us in the discussion area on Steam or send us an email at support@batovi.com. Or even better! You can join the conversation with our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/dJAenYrz9G

notes.title: OUT NOW! and FREE for everyone!
notes.content:
Finally, today we are launching the game!!!
Thanks to all those who provided feedback during the early access stage. Thanks to your contributions, the game has improved and is now ready to be released :)
And it's free for everyone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787814/e901669cb5944a1492ae4669440331010b886194.png

What's new?
Casual Matches
- We have separated casual matches, creating an area for them. Here you can invite your friends to play friendly matches, being able to configure the conditions of each match to your liking.
- And most importantly, for these matches each player can choose their preferred team, whether it be a national team or a club, you will have available the formation and potential of the chosen club!
- But also, now for every new friend you play a friendly match with, you will earn 1000 gold coins to use in the store! Get a unique ball, an original stadium, or whatever you like!

Ranked Matches
This is where you shine with your team and where the real competition lies, and we have made several improvements.
- Matchmaking for ranked matches is now prioritized to find opponents at your own level, and if none are found, it expands that range until an opponent is found. We have now added the option to only limit the search to opponents within your range, if you prefer not to play and wait, to play with someone outside your range.
- We have created a leaderboard that highlights those in the top positions and informs you of your position.
- We have added more information to the end-of-match summary, so you can also see the coins earned and the evolution of your MMR, which will determine the league you should play in.
- We have improved the end-of-match screen for ranked matches so you can see not only the XP earned in that match, but also
- We have adjusted the balance of the ranked leagues to make the matches more competitive.
- And for all those who play a ranked match during this first week of launch, you will earn 1000 gold coins to customize your team in the store to your liking!

Also!
- We have improved the information at the start and end of the match, to give more clarity to the fact that there are 2 simultaneous matches and highlighting the results on both teams.
- We have increased the frequency with which you receive information from the remote match.
- At the end of a half, when you have to wait for the remote match to finish, you can now know which minute of the game is being played.
- Finally, we have fixed small bugs and minor details.


In this new stage, we need everyone's contribution to increase the user base and enhance matchmaking possibilities... As a reward, there are tons of gold coins waiting for you! :)

Thank you for joining us on this journey! We hope you enjoy this new adventure as much as we enjoyed creating it... and now its time to challenge your friends or dive into ranked competitions!

notes.title: Remote Replays and more!
notes.content:
Remote Replays
Now you can watch the best plays from the remote match!
At the end of the game, in addition to being able to watch the replays of the best plays from the local match, you can now also watch the replays of the best plays from the remote match and find out how well your team did under your direction.

Better Matchmaking
We've made adjustments to prioritize matchmaking with players you haven't played with yet.

Balancing
We've tweaked the game balance to enhance the experience for both seasoned players and newcomers.

Minor Improvements
 To keep you more informed about the remote match, we've reduced the time for displaying remote statistics.
 We've improved the readability of your team's current formation on the strategy panel.
Bug Fixes
 Fixed a bug that caused the match to freeze at the end of the first or second half if the opponent left the game.
 A bug in the calculation of experience points (XP) earned at the end of the match has been fixed.
 Fixed a bug that prevented exiting the match search screen on some occasions.
How to give feedback
